body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52281

#### PR description:

This PR fixes `getEventContent.py`. It is patched to deliver also the content of `hltOutputDQMTestDataScouting`  to the FEVT and DEBUG data-tiers, while avoiding duplication of the scouting collections in several derived data-tiers.

#### PR validation:

`getHLT.sh` with these changes runs.
